text_block_list.text:
My mind dwells only on Manhattan Cafe's
immense ability. I decide to
make my
nightly sojourn to the track once more,
when...
Bzzt.
The lights in my office go out.

It saves me the trouble of having to hit all
the switches myself at
least. I leave the
pitch-black room behind.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Once more, and this time...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This time... I'll catch up to you...

It appears that she is running after that
"friend" of hers this evening as
well.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tch... So far...

Unlike before, though, her steps are
erratic. Maybe she's too fixated
on
catching up to her "friend" to maintain a
stable pace...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant... I'm still... not there...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Good evening.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But... why? ...You can't even...

I can't see her. But it's for that very reason
that I want to know more.
What style is she
using? When does she make for the finish
line?

If I knew what kind of technique her rival
was employing, then I'd be
able to offer
her some advice. She's trying so hard. I
really want to do
what I can for her...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: My friend is... very fast...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

Something tells me she's not too keen on
opening up about this.

For the next few evenings, I make it a
habit to visit the training
course.

Something strange happens every time.
Books falling off shelves, or
the TV
seemingly turning itself on... I even
encounter a jammed door
once more...

Luckily, Manhattan Cafe seems to be
getting used to my visits as well.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Um... She's a bit wild today... Like she's
really motivated.

Though she is still a bit apprehensive, she
shares a little more about
her friend with
me on each passing night.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I'm really not having much luck with this
whole scouting thing. How
about you?

My evenings spent with Manhattan Cafe
have all served to make me
want to be her
trainer.

The only catch is—I can't see her friend,
and I don't know if that'll be
a
deal-breaker.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I got some good advice yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That trainer... probably thinks I'm strange.
And the advice might just
be an excuse to
watch...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...But... if I'm being honest...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I feel like... even by a little bit... just a
little bit...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I've... been able to close the distance
between us.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...
Maybe... I can count on a visit... tonight
as well.

I fully intend to watch her train this
evening, but I can't help but
wonder if I'm
starting to become a nuisance.
Clack.
The door opens without issue...

But I feel as if I'm dragged through it by
some immense force.

I quickly brush it off and make for the
track.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Good evening. You're here... a bit earlier
than usual...
I can sense a hint of relief in her voice.

The next day, I go out in search of
Manhattan Cafe at the courses
once again.
I'm greeted by a different face instead.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho, searching for Cafe, are we? You're
not like most of the other
trainers, then.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Why don't you come with me
instead? Your mannerisms
fascinate me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Isn't that...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to my laboratory! Impressive, is
it not? Oh, and the other
half is Cafe's
space.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I would urge you not to touch anything
over there. I rummaged
through her
articles once, and the amount of research
material that
spontaneously combusted in
the aftermath was enough to bring me to

tears.

What a strange space. Though I can
observe it with my own eyes, it
feels as if it
lies within a separate dimension entirely.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps if I were a psychologist, I would
be more keen on unraveling
its mysteries.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, though. What do you think of this
"friend" that Cafe is always
speaking of?
Do you believe she exists?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see. "Existence" itself begs definition, but
setting that aside—you
trust in that which
neither you nor I, nor anyone else can
physically
observe.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Not very scientific of you, I must say. What
gives you such
confidence?

Merely shifting your position can change
your field of view. Surely it
follows that
things can exist outside our perception,
visible only to
another.

Thinking this argument to be ironclad, I
express it to Agnes
Tachyon...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha! Wonderful! Even I cannot
deny that there is a plethora of

possibilities yet unknown!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. I trust now that you won't be a
waste of my time.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling quite invigorated indeed.
Come, let me prepare you some
tea.
What? Don't fuss over the incandescent
glow!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
So even without seeing my friend, that
trainer...
